Nora (PM): Quick sync: AcmeCorp asked for a rollout plan that prioritizes latency-sensitive routes but preserves quality. We need a defensible staged plan, rollback gates, and a way for Sales to opt specific tenants into the beta.

Claire (Sales): We'll want a simple opt-in flow for the top 10 accounts. They may request a synchronous demo window. Can we promise a 2-hour rollback SLA if they report issues?

Priya (SRE): 2-hour rollback SLA is fine if we have an automated kill-switch + playbook. Needs dashboards + pager mapping. Also want per-tenant rate caps so a noisy tenant doesn't skew canary metrics.

Diego (Eng): Proposed approach: feature flag + tenant cohorts + regional warmup + model-variant fallback. High level phases:
1) internal (1%)
2) partner opt-ins (5%)
3) priority customers (25%)
4) global roll (100%)
We can add region-specific delays for regions with known p99 spikes.

Akash (QA): Tests I'd like before each phase:
- end-to-end latency smoke (p50/p95/p99)
- golden prompt regression check (shadow run)
- fallback correctness (X-RW-Fallback header present)
We should gate on two consecutive green windows.

Jonas (Data): I'll provide baseline per-route and per-tenant histograms. Recommendation: use 5m windows with a rolling median filter and anomaly detection. For canaries use both absolute delta and relative percent change.

Diego (Eng): Config sketch for the flag and gating rules:
```
flag: latency_switch_v1
cohorts:
  - name: internal
    pct: 1
  - name: partners
    pct: 5
  - name: priority
    pct: 25
rollout_rules:
  region_overrides:
    ap-south: delay_until: warmed
auto_gates:
  p95_delta_ms: 25
  error_rate: 0.01
  consecutive_windows: 2
  window: 5m
fallback:
  model_variant: quant8_small
  header: X-RW-Fallback: true
```
Note: we'll include token-bucket tenant caps (default 10rps) to protect canaries.

Priya (SRE): Ops notes:
- Warmup: pre-allocate warmed nodes 30 minutes before moving traffic for region overrides.
- Circuit-breaker: if queue_depth_95 > 80% OR GPU_util > 90% -> immediate pause.
- Auto-rollback: on gate fail, flip flag off and run mitigation (drain + revert routing).
- Pager rule: fallback_count spike -> page SRE-primary.

Claire (Sales): If we auto-rollback during a customer demo, we need a customer-facing message template. Can Product own that?

Nora (PM): Yes, we'll craft a short template. Also adding an admin toggle per-tenant so Sales/CS can manually opt-out. That must be auditable.

Akash (QA): For shadow vs live: shadow runs should include both model variants and compute a similarity score. If similarity < threshold -> block promotion. But shadow won't test capacity so we still need canary.

Diego (Eng): Good call. We'll add a shadow pipeline that mirrors requests to the fallback variant and logs similarity metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-style + embedding cosine). Block if similarity drop > 12%.

Jonas (Data): Metrics to show on Console: per-route p95, fallback_rate, similarity_score_avg, per-tenant traffic share, queue_depth_p95. I'll produce a dashboard template.

Priya (SRE): Rollout cadence suggestion:
- internal 1% for 15m (smoke + logs)
- partners 5% for 30m (observe similarity + latency)
- priority 25% staged over 2 hours (10% -> 25% after checks)
- global ramp 100% gated by region health
Each step requires manual confirm OR automated gate pass.

Diego (Eng): Implementation items and owners:
- feature flag + token-bucket caps: Diego (tomorrow)
- shadow similarity pipeline: Diego + Jonas (3 days)
- dashboards + alerts: Jonas + Priya (tomorrow)
- admin opt UI + copy: Nora + Claire + Akash (2 days)
- rollback playbook: Priya (tomorrow)
DeployBot: rollout scheduled: latency_switch_v1 -> internal cohort at 2026-03-24T14:00Z (1%).

Claire (Sales): Thanks, please tag me on the opt-in doc so I can start coordinating with accounts.

Nora (PM): Launch criteria (all must be true):
- shadow similarity >= 88% across sampled prompts for 24h OR within two successful canary windows
- p95 delta <= 25ms on canary cohorts for two consecutive windows
- per-tenant cap enforced and tested
- admin opt-in/out + customer comms ready
- rollback playbook validated in staging

Akash (QA): I'll run a staged QA run that simulates noisy tenants to validate token-bucket behavior.

Diego (Eng): One more: add an emergency fallback variant that is CPU-only (lighter model) if GPU pressure is extreme. That gives SRE a less risky path.

Priya (SRE): Good idea. We'll define fallback severity levels: soft (quantized GPU variant) and hard (CPU light model). Hard fallback will raise an urgent alert.

Nora (PM): OK folks, I'll update the ticket and schedule a short live-check call at +20m after the internal run. If anything blocks the rollout, say so now. :rocket:
